fact: A Namibian project announced in September 2026 a planned 600-item Oshindonga and Oshikwanyama machine-translation benchmark dataset, with an internal 423-item build existing and first public release targeted for Q4 2026 under CC-BY-4.0.
title: The Ongiini-Eval-OW Benchmark: A Concept Paper for the Planned Benchmarking of Machine Translation and Large Language Models on Oshindonga and Oshikwanyama
